mapper.select: /* boardInqyDao1010 : 공지사항 시퀀스 조회 */ SELECT 'BRD_' || LPAD(NVL(MAX(REPLACE(BRD_ID,'BRD_')),0) + 1,4,0) AS BRD_ID FROM BOARD

/* boardInqyDao1030 : 공지사항 상세 조회 */ SELECT B.BRD_ID , B.BRD_TITLE , B.BRD_CONT , B.EMP_IDX , E.EMP_NM , E.ORG_CD , O.ORG_NM , E.RANK_CD , R.RANK_NM , B.READ_HIT , B.FILE_ID , B.REG_IDX , TO_CHAR(B.REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REG_DT , B.MOD_IDX , TO_CHAR(B.MOD_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS MOD_DT , B.USE_YN , B.DISP_ORDER , B.REMARK FROM BOARD B LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_INFO E ON B.EMP_IDX = E.EMP_IDX LEFT OUTER JOIN ORG O ON O.ORG_CD = E.ORG_CD AND O.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN RANK R ON R.RANK_CD = E.RANK_CD AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE B.BRD_ID = #{brdId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y'
